'''Darth Scabrous's tower''' was a massive, [[black]] structure that dominated the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]] resided within the tower, wherein he practiced dark experiments into [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. It was within the tower that he created [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|The Sickness]]&mdash;a virus capable of killing living flesh and subsequently reanimating it. The tower was partially destroyed in [[3645 BBY]], when its uppermost levels were blown away by Scabrous's security [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] stationed on the academy grounds.
